name: patient_owns_mobile_phone
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient owns a mobile phone.
when_true: Set to true if the patient owns a mobile phone.
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not own a mobile phone.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient owns a mobile phone.
